title: sessions/{id}/peers/{peerId}
description: The signaling document of a remote camera in Firestore, schema version 1 (docs/DATA-MODEL.md §10, docs/RTC.md, docs/PLAN.md T4.0): the WebRTC offer of a phone that joins a session as a camera (the caller) and the host's answer (the callee), with the candidates of each side in the subcollections callerCandidates and calleeCandidates (cloud-candidate.schema.json). The session's owner alone reads and writes it; it is never in the dataset.

owner.description: The Firebase Authentication uid of the account that owns the session, which both devices are signed in to.

role.description: What the peer is to the session; phase 4 has cameras only.

createdMs.description: When the phone wrote the document, in ms, on its clock.

tokenHash.description: SHA-256 of the pairing token the phone presents, as 64 lowercase hex digits: the session document's pairing.tokenHash when the token is the one the host shows.

state.description: offered: the phone wrote its offer and waits; answered: the host answered; closed: the phone left.

offer.description: The phone's offer, as RTCSessionDescriptionInit has it: its type and its SDP, of at most 20,000 characters; null before an ICE restart's new offer is written.

answer.description: The host's answer, as RTCSessionDescriptionInit has it: its type and its SDP, of at most 20,000 characters; null until the host answers.
